instruction: Please help me configure VS Code to auto-save files after a delay of 1000ms.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring auto-save feature in VS Code with specific delay. Similar complexity to original task but involves multiple related settings. Uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify both files.autoSave and files.autoSaveDelay are correctly configured.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both required settings: files.autoSave='afterDelay' and files.autoSaveDelay=1000
Getter (get_vm_file) retrieves the correct VS Code settings file from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Metric (check_json_settings) uses robust comparison logic with sentinel pattern to verify all expected key-value pairs
Complete coverage: both auto-save mode and delay duration are verified
Expected values are semantically correct for VS Code configuration schema
State is persistent (settings.json saved automatically) - no postconfig needed
Data flow is correct: settings file → JSON load → dict comparison
No logical edge cases - settings file will exist after configuration

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
